info.name: UmrahMart - Chat (Vendor)
info.description:
API contract untuk fitur **Chat** — semua endpoint yang digunakan role **Vendor (UMKM)**.

Base URL: `http://localhost:8080/api/v1`

## Aturan Role
Vendor (UMKM) dapat chat dengan: **Customer, Admin, CS, Finance**.

## Endpoint
- Search users: `GET /chat/users`
- Start conversation: `POST /chat`
- List conversations: `GET /vendors/chat`
- Get conversation: `GET /vendors/chat/:id`
- Send message: `POST /chat/:id/messages`
- List messages: `GET /chat/:id/messages`
- Mark as read: `PATCH /vendors/chat/:id/read`

## WebSocket (Real-time)
Endpoint: `ws://localhost:8080/api/v1/ws?token=<jwt>`
Buat WebSocket request terpisah di Postman (New → WebSocket).

request.description:
Daftar semua conversation.

Setiap conversation dilengkapi:
- `user_name` & `user_role` — info participant lawan bicara
- `last_message` & `last_message_time` — pesan terakhir
- `unread_count` — jumlah pesan belum dibaca

**Auth:** Bearer Token

request.description:

- `message` (string, required) — isi pesan
- `attachment_url` (string, optional) — URL lampiran

Setelah pesan disimpan, backend push notifikasi ke participant lawan via WebSocket.

**Auth:** Bearer Token
